convert_focalnet_checkpoint: convert a FocalNet checkpoint from Microsoft's repository to HuggingFace Transformers format
get_focalnet_config: build a FocalNet config object for a given model name with correct embed_dim, depths, and focal settings
rename_key: rename FocalNet checkpoint keys to match HuggingFace Transformers naming conventions
run_focalnet_conversion_cli: run the FocalNet conversion CLI to download and convert a model to HuggingFace format
test_conversion_accuracy: test the converted FocalNet model by verifying logits against expected values on a sample image
